seed_law: all defined-j X0(11)(F_20023) points of absolute Frobenius trace 64, quotienting by five torsion translates
source_law: process complete rational degree-2/3 Hecke neighbors for every five-translate source in each BFS frontier layer, retaining verified rows and new orbit representatives
prefix_rule: stage k uses trace-64 seed columns, all newly reached orbit columns through layer k, the 490 frozen seed rows, and accepted Hecke rows from layers 0 through k
rank_rule: include all Q+jG hits internal to the stage table for 1<=j<=radius; contract shift components and compute exact GF(4021) quotient rank with anchored generator row
work_record: retain cumulative frontier source count, l=2/3 query count, accepted rows, distinct columns, shift lookup probes and successful edges separately
fresh_rebuild_gate: rerun the first naturally produced stage with full anchored rank from the source law and compare its sources, row multiset and columns to the saved ledger
